_README: External-book receipts captured on 2026-10-24 from a research sandbox (browser-grade fetch),
because the GitHub Actions runner is blocked by both of these venues:
* bo3.gg            -> HTTP 200 from Actions but the price cells are client-rendered, so a
runner receives no prices (recorded in data/corroboration.json).
Every decimal price below is transcribed verbatim from the linked page at the stated UTC time.
Nothing is inferred, averaged or copied from another row. See research/LONGTAIL_VENUES.md.
CLOCK CONVENTION (verified 2026-10-24, corrects the 'UTC-4' note in data/corroboration.json):
both pages display US Eastern local time, which is UTC-4 during EDT and UTC-5 during EST.
bo3.gg / EGamersWorld 13:00 on 24.10.2026 (EDT, UTC-4) == Hotspawn fixture 1067688 at 17:00Z.
EGamersWorld 00:00 on 10.11.2026 (EST, UTC-5)          == Hotspawn fixture 1081421 at 05:00Z.
EGamersWorld 04:00 on 11.11.2026 (EST, UTC-5)          == Hotspawn fixture 1081423 at 09:00Z.
US daylight saving ends 2026-11-01, so any receipt captured after that date must be read as UTC-5.

coverage_observations.observation: bo3.gg's LoL match centre listed exactly 8 cards on 2026-10-24, all of them 'Worlds 2026' (s-tier). No tier-2, national or academy league appeared anywhere on the page, so bo3.gg cannot price the long tail of the Hotspawn list.
coverage_observations.verbatim: s-tier | Time | Match | Prediction | Tournament ... Worlds 2026 (x8)

coverage_observations.observation: EGamersWorld listed 8 Worlds 2026 cards for 2026-10-24 plus exactly three non-Worlds cards: LGC 2026 Rising (2026-10-27) and two LCP 2027 Promotion cards (2026-11-10, 2026-11-11). That is the widest external LoL coverage found anywhere so far - 11 priced series against Hotspawn's 241 scheduled cards - and it is still confined to international/regional-tier events. Not one of the 29 national, academy or third-division tournaments on Hotspawn is priced.
